location_description: Nicole Anais Petallides (born September 20, 1971) is an American journalist who serves as the anchor for the online-only TD Ameritrade Network, which is wholly owned and operated by Charles Schwab Corporation as a result of their acquisition of TD Ameritrade in 2020. Previously, she was an anchor for Fox Business. Gained experience at Dow Jones Television, CNBC, Bloomberg.
